title: Clinton-era investigation finds 40 tons of Nazi gold shipped from Lisbon

tellings.quote: short while. They found 40 tons of gold. 40 tons of gold that had been shipped out of the Bank of Lisbon by submarine.

plain: An investigation during the Clinton administration in the 1990s is said to have found 40 tons of Nazi gold that had been shipped out of the Bank of Lisbon by submarine. A researcher named Peter Levenda mentions this to Michels without naming a source, as a sign of how much wealth the Nazis moved out of Europe in secret.
